spans.s:
रेक् (ऋ,) रेकृ r. 1st cl. (रेकते)
 1. To suspect or think probable.
 2. To
excite or entertain doubt: in the last case with आङ् usually
prefixed.

रेक mf. (-कः-का)
 1. Doubt, uncertainty.
 2. Fear, apprehension.
 m.
(-कः)
 1. Looseness, purging.
 2. An outcaste, a low man.
 3. A frog.
E. रेक् to suspect, to fear, aff. अच्, or रिच् to purge, aff. घञ् ।

रेकणस् n. (-णः) Gold.
 E. रिच् to divide, Unādi aff. असुन्, नुट् augment,
and च changed to क ।
